data_sources.call_report_data.json: Balance-sheet RCON schedule items in JSON format, keyed by MDRM code
data_sources.xbrl_supplement.xml: Income-statement RIAD and supplemental RCONA items in XBRL instance format. Context IDs map to reporting periods via xbrli:context definitions.

expression_syntax.PCTOFANN: PCTOFANN(num, den) = (num / den) * ANN * 100 - annualized percentage
expression_syntax.CAVG04X: CAVG04X(#uc:CONCEPT) - calendar-year average within same year, max 4 periods. For Q1: just Q1. For Q2: avg(Q1,Q2). For Q3: avg(Q1,Q2,Q3). For Q4: avg(Q1,Q2,Q3,Q4).
expression_syntax.CAVG05X: CAVG05X(#uc:CONCEPT) - like CAVG04X but also includes prior Dec. For Q1: avg(priorQ4,Q1). For Q2: avg(priorQ4,Q1,Q2). For Q3: avg(priorQ4,Q1,Q2,Q3). For Q4: avg(priorQ4,Q1,Q2,Q3,Q4).
expression_syntax.ExistingOf: ExistingOf(concept_ref, default) - returns concept value if it exists and is not null, otherwise returns default
expression_syntax.ANN: Annualization factor for current quarter. Determined by quarter month: March->4.0, June->2.0, September->4/3, December->1.0
expression_syntax.concept_prefix_cc: cc: = Call Report concept (direct data item from JSON or XBRL sources)
